sources.name: Groundbreak DFW — Just Started Projects
sources.description: Direct list of DFW projects whose construction began within the last 60 days, sorted by recent updates.
sources.caution: Open the project record to verify the named contractor; some records identify only the developer or owner.

sources.name: Groundbreak DFW — Starting Soon Projects
sources.description: Direct list of DFW projects expected to begin construction within 90 days.
sources.caution: Starting-soon dates can move; confirm a permit, award or contractor before treating the company as a lead.

sources.name: Groundbreak DFW — Most Active General Contractors
sources.description: Direct ranking of general contractors named on the most DFW building permits during the last 90 days.
sources.caution: Exclude placeholder or malformed contractor names and verify the underlying permits before qualification.

sources.name: Groundbreak DFW — Largest Permits This Month
sources.description: Direct list of the largest DFW building permits issued during the current calendar month.
sources.caution: Permit value can be incorrect or repeated; follow the project link and verify the contractor role.

sources.name: DFW Daily Brief — Development & Openings
sources.description: Source-linked updates on new projects, permits, major openings and development decisions across DFW.
sources.caution: Some entries describe registrations or plans rather than active construction.

sources.name: DFW Online Planroom — Public Projects
sources.description: Public DFW construction listings with project names, locations, bid status, deadlines and associated companies.
sources.caution: A company on a bid-stage listing may be the owner, architect or bidding contact rather than the awarded general contractor.

sources.name: TxDOT Facilities — Awarded Contractor Listings
sources.description: Official building, renovation, repair and rehabilitation listings that identify awarded contractors and bid amounts.
sources.caution: Use rows marked Awarded for confirmed contractors; Award pending and bidder entries are not final awards.

sources.name: Zabalist — Texas Construction Bids
sources.description: Direct Texas construction bid and RFP listing assembled from public procurement records.
sources.caution: A bid opportunity identifies work to pursue, not the contractor that ultimately wins it.

sources.name: REBusinessOnline — Texas
sources.description: Frequent Texas commercial-real-estate reports that often identify developers, contractors, project size and timing.
sources.caution: The Texas feed also contains sales, leases and financing with no new construction signal.

sources.name: Bisnow — Dallas-Fort Worth
sources.description: DFW property reporting whose deal sheets frequently name developers, general contractors and construction milestones.
sources.caution: Access and article depth can vary; deal sheets also include financing and leasing items.

sources.name: Construction Dive — Commercial Building
sources.description: National reporting on significant construction awards, starts, contractors and commercial-building projects.
sources.caution: National coverage is selective and will not represent every local project.

sources.name: SaunaNews — Bathhouse Project Tracker
sources.description: The tracker previously identified by the user; it follows bathhouse projects and keeps milestone evidence explicit.
sources.caution: A narrow sector source; useful for the tracking method but low volume for general contractors.
